title: Choose long exposure from travel survival while paying correlated squared-score variance
statement: The endpoint resolvent ratio is the Laplace transform of a sum of positive exponentials. Two continuant derivatives give exposure delta=3(mu^2+v)/(2mu) and retained contrast >=8mu^2/[9(mu^2+v)]. Cooperative flow derivatives plus product Poincare bound the actual non-Gaussian exposure squared-score variance; spaced reads obey <9 S_delta^2/Q. This is a sufficient supported interface, not an optimal complete receiver.

requires: Known one-defect M-matrix diffusion with all-coordinate independent mechanical bath excitation and only the specified observed port
Stated zero or stationary start and matching finite exposure/readout law; no actuated dynamics or altered bath
Stationary bath and warranted independent Gaussian electronics PSD over the long integration
provides: At N32 the source gives delta about 22.12012149 and retention at least .85340391
assumptions: No Gaussian law is assumed for the nonlinear exposure
Low-frequency drift or colored electronics changes the interface
The independent receiver must still pay burn-in, calibration, budget and comparison
costs: Actual observation duration, initialization, correlated read spacing, exposure integration, electronics and calibration
Exact coefficient/scalar compilation is not physical data; long exposure trades time and information under its declared noise law
contract.units: Native mechanical stiffness, temperature, variance and quartic coefficient units from the supplied Gibbs model; no automatic SI-time or device calibration conversion.
contract.obstruction: A point-read fourth-moment bound can miss the shrinking variance of a long exposure.

body: Local stationary and fixed-alternative/transient scopes do not transfer by analogy. The ordinary comparator is full temporal covariance likelihood, not only a variance statistic. K, bath, metric, temperature, one hidden quartic, readout and zero drive are supplied. Supporting scalar retention/variance packets do not complete the independent receiver, burn-in/calibration budget or a physical measurement.
